# Cadet
Cadets are junior security officers in training. A cadet should understand the fundamentals of the Security Department, but is not expected to perform at the level of full officers.
1. Standard [color=#00a933]Code Green[/color] equipment is:
2. Cadets should not operate alone unless authorised by the Head of Security, and should closely tail a mentoring [color=#ffe100]Senior Officer[/color].
3. Cadets are [color=#ff0000]not[/color] to sentence arrested individuals directly unless authorised, or if there is no other option.
4. Cadets may only use lethal equipment for training purposes, or on [color=#ff0000]Code Red[/color].
5. At the discretion of the Head of Security or Captain/ACO, cadets may be field [color=#ffe100]promoted to full officers[/color] after proving their capability.
## Senior Officer Assignment Cadets are to assign themselves to a Security Officer if one is not assigned to them. This officer is responsible for oversight of the cadet, including answering of [color=#ffe100]department-related questions[/color], [color=#00a933]general mentoring[/color], and training in [color=#ff0000]firearms and arrests[/color].
Officers assigned to cadets should help explain equipment and their uses, the operation of the department, the [color=#ffe100]Corporate Law structure[/color], and any information not readily available through other means.
Cadets accompanying officers may act alongside their officer in the enactment of arrests or in pursuit of suspects. Cadets are [color=#ff0000]highly discouraged[/color] from acting alone.
